title: Launcher test owner-alive check can be fooled by PID reuse, leaving an orphaned barrier fixture waiting forever
outcome: Fixture processes in scripts/test-launcher.test.mjs detect their owning test process's death even if its PID is reused, for example by comparing the owner's start time or by watching a handle whose closure signals the owner's death. An orphaned barrier waiter cannot outlive its owner indefinitely.
acceptance: Launcher test owner-alive check can be fooled by PID reuse, leaving an orphaned barrier fixture waiting forever is done
